clips.title: The story
paras: At Beggar's Haunt, Forsaken agents watch the eastern approaches from an old Stormwind tower. It rises on a hillside in northeastern Duskwood, near the mountain road to Deadwind Pass.

Beggar's Haunt overlooks the hills east of Manor Mistmantle. Stormwind once kept guards in this tower to watch the kingdom's eastern approaches. As Duskwood fell into gloom, patrols withdrew to Darkshire and left the tower to the elements. Forsaken agents now use the ruins to study the region and watch it from within Alliance territory. They include members of the Royal Apothecary Society and the Deathstalkers.

A twisting path behind the tower descends to Knight's Hollow, a secluded pool and waterfall. An unmarked grave lies there between two hooded stone statues like the guardians beside the Dark Portal. Nearby graves include the burial place of an Unknown Soldier. They recall forgotten clashes along this frontier, fought long before the Forsaken took the watchtower.
